notes.title: Release Date & New Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello there fisherpeople! Let's see what we caught in our net.


Release Date
Salty news for y'all: the Loan Shark is coming for payback on 8th August 2025!

Get ready for a fishing trip amidst water, debt, and blood.


New Trailer
To celebrate the announcement of the release date, we put up an updated version of our trailer.

It shares the same structure and beats as the previous one, but showcases all the little tweaks we made to improve the look of the game.

Let us know what you think!

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/y6Q1gFEot3I"][/dynamiclink]

Stay fishy and wishlist our game!

- Studio Carota
